model_conventions.checked_scope: The source conclusions on their stated finite-dimensional norm domain; this convention does not alter any payoff, equilibrium, or product-maximization conclusion.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: The source's finite-dimensional norm is represented by a `SourceNorm` together with the compact and convex sublevel, measurability, continuity, and perturbation-continuity hypotheses used by the existence and single-genre proofs.
model_conventions.why_needed: The reusable formal API permits norm-like cost functions more general than a mathematical norm, so the finite-dimensional regularity used implicitly by the source must be explicit at the relevant proof endpoints.
